name: 習得率と次の復習時期
prompt: Redesign the existing Japanese mastery/review card as a portrait mobile screen, matching the native preview’s exact crop, content and hierarchy. The native preview is authoritative for Japanese text, order and layout. The original Speak screenshot is context for the course row and its photo only; do not copy its blue bars or tinted gray page. The attached user example is palette guidance only: white surfaces, neutral outlines, solid green active states; do not copy its geometry or icons. Keep the main card and all sections white, separators light neutral gray, text near-black/medium gray, and mastery/progress bars plus the primary button flat forest green (#1F6444). Preserve the existing circular group photo from the native preview exactly: retain the same people, crop, color and placement; do not redraw, retouch, recolor, or substitute the faces. Preserve exact Japanese content: 自分のコースから; 1つの概念; 習得率：100%; はじめての会話・第1部; 100%; 次のおすすすめの復習：364日後; 復習を始める. Match the course progress row and button positions. Do not add icons or extra copy. No pastel tint backgrounds, mint/cyan/blue fills, gradients, shadows, or decorative effects. Keep the design clean and accessible.
reviewNotes: No-tint palette follows the preference. Needs one correction for 390x410 native crop, removal of status/blank space, and photo scale/placement.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
